def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    # divider row: the full-width non-background solid row (color 2)
    div=None
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(r))==1 and r[0] not in (0,5,9) and r[0]!=0:
            # candidate: color 2 divider
            if r[0]==2: div=i
    # shape color: any cell not background(0/5/9) and not divider color
    colors={}
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        if i==div: continue
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v not in (0,5,9,2): colors[v]=colors.get(v,0)+1
    sc=max(colors,key=colors.get)
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==sc]
    rows_shape=sorted({i for i,j in cells})
    top,bot=rows_shape[0],rows_shape[-1]
    bg=0 if 0 in {v for r in g for v in r} else (5 if 5 in {v for r in g for v in r} else 9)
    # clear original shape
    for i,j in cells: g[i][j]=bg
    if top<div:
        gap=div-1-bot   # rows available between shape and divider
        shift=min(gap,bot-top+1)  # move until adjacent
        shift=bot-top+1 if (div-1-bot)>=(bot-top+1) else gap
        # simpler: new bottom = div-1 if gap >= height else bot+gap
        h=bot-top+1
        newbot=div-1 if (div-1-bot)>=h else bot+gap
        newtop=newbot-h+1
        line_row=newtop-1
        side=1
    else:
        h=bot-top+1
        gap=top-(div+1)
        newtop=div+1 if gap>=h else top-gap
        newbot=newtop+h-1
        line_row=newbot+1
        side=-1
    # stamp shape shifted
    minc=min(j for i,j in cells)
    stamp={}
    for i,j in cells: stamp[(i-top,j-minc)]=1
    for (dr,dc) in stamp:
        r=newtop+dr; c=minc+dc
        g[r][c]=sc
    if 0<=line_row<H:
        for j in range(W): g[line_row][j]=8
    return g
